CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 3
   C. 21
   D. 15

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

7. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 25

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

12. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

14. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

17. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

18. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 13

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 14

22. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

24. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
